metadata.content: Only TextBlock.kind == abstract text; labels, titles, full text excluded
metadata.identity: Unique PMID; input duplicate PMID, invalid PMID and blank abstracts rejected

conditions.A: Reference: whitespace tokens + ir_hw1.preprocessing.normalize; attached punctuation retained
conditions.B: Baseline: ir_hw1.preprocessing.tokenize token.term in source order; no added filtering or expansion
conditions.C: B + remove the fixed project stopword list
conditions.D: C + ir_hw1.preprocessing.stem_term; NLTK Porter MARTIN_EXTENSIONS on ASCII alphabetic tokens only

metadata.unicode_normalization: HW1 normalize: NFC then casefold; right apostrophe and supported Unicode hyphens normalized
metadata.punctuation_caveat: HW1 keeps decimal numbers and internal supported hyphens/apostrophes; GLP-1, IL6, 3.5 and beta-cell compounds stay intact; other punctuation delimits tokens

stopwords.source: Project-authored explicit English function-word list; no downloaded NLTK corpus is required.
stopwords.purpose: A fixed, reviewable experiment condition, not a claim that these words are always irrelevant to retrieval.

stemming.scope: ASCII alphabetic only; compounds, decimals and non-ASCII tokens preserved

metadata.ranking: Descending CF; ties sorted by Unicode term, ordinal ranks 1..V; no tied mean ranks
metadata.segments: head to max(2,floor(.01*V)); middle to max(head+2,floor(.1*V)); tail remainder; cap at V and reserve 2 tail points if V>=6; actual bounds in each result
metadata.r_squared: 1-SSE/SST; null for constant frequency or insufficient points; not a power-law test
metadata.rmse: sqrt(SSE/n) in log10(CF) space, not original CF space
metadata.idf: log10(N/DF); no smoothing; no additive constant
metadata.term_selection: Condition B: top 10, predefined vocabulary-rank quantiles, present domain/negation terms; fill to 20 if vocabulary permits
limitations: Descriptive OLS on dependent ordered counts does not establish a power-law distribution
A is a whitespace reference; primary comparison B/C/D follows the fixed HW1 token contract
HW1 preserves supported compounds and decimals but is not a biomedical entity recognizer
Rare terms and singleton ties may dominate full-range log regression
An experiment can contain fewer than 20 terms only for small test corpora
